conventions.floors: Use specific dungeon-page original-game exploration totals; count numbered boss floors, but keep unnumbered rescue and story clearings as separate scene maps. Walkthrough narrative occasionally counts a scene clearing as another floor.
conventions.postgame: Postgame routes branch. Walkthrough chapter numbering is editorial, not a mandatory total order.
conventions.representation: Dungeon counts are canonical source counts. Any shortened play mode should be labeled as an adaptation, while preserving canonical floor metadata.

snow_path.scope: Original Generation III sections; before Frosty Forest and Mt. Freeze, inaccessible after Mt. Freeze peak

events: Personality quiz chooses the human-turned-Pokemon hero; player names hero and chooses partner.
Partner finds the amnesiac hero. Butterfree asks for Caterpie's rescue.

main_campaign.name: Tiny Woods
events: Rescue Caterpie; receive basic berries.
Partner introduces the home; establish and name rescue team.

main_campaign.name: Thunderwave Cave
events: Receive rescue kit and letter; separate two Magnemite fused by unusual magnetism.
unlocks: Pelipper Post Office and job board

main_campaign.name: Mt. Steel
main_campaign.unlock: Complete at least two ordinary jobs after Thunderwave; Dugtrio requests Diglett rescue.
events: Magnemite helps retrieve Diglett across the gap.
Wigglytuff introduces Friend Areas; Magnemite joins.

main_campaign.name: Sinister Woods
main_campaign.unlock: Ordinary jobs introduce Team Meanies, then Caterpie requests Metapod rescue.
events: Rival team competes over the rescue; save Metapod.

main_campaign.name: Silent Chasm
events: Jumpluff asks Shiftry for help; Team A.C.T. persuades him.
Shiftry fails to return. Rescue Jumpluff, but Zapdos takes Shiftry to Mt. Thunder.

main_campaign.name: Mt. Thunder
events: Defeat Zapdos and rescue Shiftry; Team A.C.T. recognizes the team's ability.

main_campaign.name: Great Canyon
events: Xatu links the hero's transformation to the crisis; Gengar overhears.
Whiscash tells the Ninetales legend; Gardevoir appears in dreams.
Gengar accuses the hero. Team leaves town under pursuit.

main_campaign.name: Lapis Cave
events: Fugitive journey begins; normal town access and first-visit recruitment are unavailable.

main_campaign.name: Mt. Blaze
events: Cross volcanic terrain while fleeing pursuers; confront Moltres.

main_campaign.name: Frosty Forest
events: Articuno confronts the team over disrupted snow.
Absol intervenes and joins the team.

main_campaign.name: Mt. Freeze
events: Team A.C.T. catches up; Ninetales interrupts the confrontation.
Ninetales clears the hero. Earthquakes have awakened Groudon.
A.C.T. investigates Groudon; hero returns to town.

main_campaign.name: Uproar Forest
main_campaign.unlock: After Mt. Freeze and at least three jobs, accept Wynaut/Wobbuffet's Mankey request.
events: Reward Chestnut persuades Mankey to renovate Team Base.
Provide two further Chestnuts when work stops; Chestnuts appear on floor 9.
features: First storyline dungeon with Monster Houses

main_campaign.name: Magma Cavern
main_campaign.unlock: Complete Uproar, progress jobs, finish base; failed rescue expedition leads team underground.
events: Blastoise, Octillery and Golem fail to rescue A.C.T.; player team follows.
Defeat Groudon and rescue A.C.T.

main_campaign.name: Sky Tower
main_campaign.entry_first_time: Teleport Gem; Xatu and allies support ascent.
main_campaign.entry_postgame: Fly HM or a Pokemon knowing Fly
events: Xatu reveals the falling meteor is causing the disasters.
Gardevoir reveals the hero accepted the mission to save this world.
Rayquaza must be defeated before agreeing to destroy the meteor.
Rayquaza destroys the meteor with Hyper Beam.
Gengar returns the hero from the netherworld after the explosion.
The world's Pokemon celebrate. The hero must leave and return to human life.
After credits, the hero's wish to stay is fulfilled; they reappear at Team Base.
Postgame opens evolution at Luminous Cave, flexible party leadership, legendary recruitment and new expeditions.

postgame_routes.name: Luminous Cave
events: Snubbull has become Granbull; Alakazam explains evolution.
Enter the cave beneath Whiscash Pond alone to evolve eligible Pokemon.

stages.name: Stormy Sea
stages.unlock: Talk Medicham, Lombre, then Whiscash after ending; obtain Dive.
stages.entry: Dive HM in inventory or known move
stages.reward: Kyogre can be recruited on first clear; opens Buried Relic news route.

stages.name: Buried Relic
stages.unlock: Stormy Sea clear; read newsletter, speak Lombre then Shiftry.
stages.objective: Combine three Parts into Music Box. Carry it for possible Mew appearances on floors 36-98.
stages.special: Mew recruitment ends expedition; using Music Box breaks it. Matching Part or Music Box also enables corresponding Regi recruitment.

treasures.80: Cut; key, water crossing and wall access

postgame_routes.name: Latios and Latias route
postgame_routes.unlock: Obtain Surf from Solar Cave and buy Southern Island Friend Area (9500 Poke).
events: Latios steals TMs trying to save Latias, injured by meteor debris.

stages.name: Pitfall Valley
stages.terminal: Rescue Latias on floor 25 using Teleport Gem.

postgame_routes.name: Lugia and Deoxys route
postgame_routes.unlock: Recruit Zapdos, Moltres and Articuno after ending; clear Stormy Sea and Pitfall Valley; speak Alakazam and visit Legendary Island.
events: Birds grant Vortex Stone and access to Silver Trench.

stages.name: Silver Trench
stages.entry: Water Pokemon plus Dive HM/known move
stages.special: Whole-floor Monster Houses on 15, 35, 55 and 75; no midpoint rest.
stages.reward: Recruit Lugia to unlock Meteor Cave.

stages.name: Meteor Cave
stages.unlock: Recruit Lugia; Xatu and Blastoise describe a cave formed by meteor debris.
stages.entry: One Pokemon; three bag items plus held item
stages.special: Defeat Deoxys mirage on each floor 1-19 to unlock stairs.

postgame_routes.name: Spinda's mirage Pokemon quest
postgame_routes.unlock: Retrieve Surf in Solar Cave; help collapsed Spinda and receive Clear Wing; consult Xatu at Great Canyon.
postgame_routes.entry: Surf required for fields and Mt. Faraway

stages.name: Fiery Field
stages.reward: Clear Wing becomes Red Wing; unlock Lightning Field.

stages.name: Lightning Field
stages.reward: Red Wing becomes Sunset Wing; unlock Northwind Field.

stages.name: Northwind Field
stages.reward: Sunset Wing becomes Rainbow Wing; unlock Mt. Faraway.

stages.name: Mt. Faraway
stages.treasure: Friend Bow behind locked door on 30
stages.reward: Mirage is Ho-Oh; return to Spinda to conclude quest.

stages.name: Western Cave
stages.unlock: Recruit Ho-Oh; Blastoise and Charizard report a powerful Pokemon.
stages.treasure: Beauty Scarf behind locked door on 59
stages.recruitment: Mewtwo cannot join on first clear; requires Cryptic Cave Friend Area.

postgame_routes.recruitment: Beasts and Ho-Oh cannot join on initial story encounter; after Ho-Oh is defeated, revisit with appropriate Friend Areas.

postgame_routes.name: Wish Cave and Gengar's redemption
postgame_routes.unlock: Clear Pitfall Valley and own Sky Blue Plains; follow Ekans/Medicham conversations over days, then accept Medicham rescue request.

stages.name: Wish Cave full expedition
stages.entry: Surf; compulsory save; carried money zeroed; temporary level 1 reset
stages.reward: Recruit Jirachi, or decline recruitment while carrying Wish Stone to choose a wish.
wishes: Rank increase or eligible new recruit

stages.name: Return to Mt. Freeze
stages.unlock: After Medicham rescue, follow Ekans/Medicham dialogue until Gengar requests help.
stages.objective: Escort Gengar to Ninetales; receive 9-Tail Crest.

stages.name: Murky Cave
stages.objective: Escort Gengar; confront his past and release Gardevoir's curse.
stages.reward: Mobile Scarf; Gardevoir can join from Pokemon Square.

postgame_routes.resolution: Gengar was the selfish human from the legend. His remorse frees Gardevoir; her memories of him are gone.
postgame_routes.redemption_additional_prerequisite: Stormy Sea clear, per Team Meanies character article; broad walkthrough omits this condition.

other_major_dungeons.name: Howling Forest
other_major_dungeons.unlock: Renovate Team Base, own Sky Blue Plains, accept Smeargle rescue request.
other_major_dungeons.reward: Smeargle joins; can paint Team Base flag.

other_major_dungeons.name: Joyous Tower
other_major_dungeons.unlock: Clear Pitfall Valley and own Sky Blue Plains.
other_major_dungeons.entry: Temporary level 1; money zeroed; original games allow items and up to three entrants.
other_major_dungeons.purpose: Rare Pokemon recruitment, including several starter choices and Chansey.

other_major_dungeons.name: Purity Forest
other_major_dungeons.unlock: Clear Pitfall Valley and own Sky Blue Plains.
other_major_dungeons.entry: Solo; temporary level 1 and base IQ; no money or items brought in; no normal recruitment.
other_major_dungeons.reward: Celebi automatically joins on floor 99, without a fight.

other_major_dungeons.name: Southern Cavern
other_major_dungeons.unlock: Receive Boulder Cave Friend Area as mission reward.

other_major_dungeons.name: Wyvern Hill
other_major_dungeons.unlock: Receive Dragon Cave Friend Area as mission reward.
other_major_dungeons.special: Locked Sun Ribbon on 20, Fly on 30; Dragon Scale on 29-30.

other_major_dungeons.name: Solar Cave
other_major_dungeons.unlock: After ending, speak Medicham, Lombre and Whiscash.
other_major_dungeons.special: Dive on 10 (key and water), Waterfall on 15 (key), Surf on 20 (water).

other_major_dungeons.name: Darknight Relic
other_major_dungeons.special: One-tile hallway sight; rare wall items on selected floors.

other_major_dungeons.name: Grand Sea
other_major_dungeons.unlock: Buy Serene Sea after ending; requires Dive.
other_major_dungeons.special: DeepSeaScale on 15; DeepSeaTooth on 25; water crossing needed.

other_major_dungeons.name: Waterfall Pond
other_major_dungeons.special: Recruit Squirtle, Totodile and Mudkip; no Monster Houses.

other_major_dungeons.name: Unown Relic
other_major_dungeons.unlock: Buy BOTH Aged Chamber AN and Aged Chamber O? after ending.
other_major_dungeons.special: All 28 Unown forms; no other species.

other_major_dungeons.name: Far-off Sea
other_major_dungeons.unlock: Buy Serene Sea after ending; Water Pokemon and Dive required.
other_major_dungeons.special: No leader switching. Locked Wide Slash on 50, Vacuum-Cut on 72; Lapras recruitment.

other_major_dungeons.name: Fantasy Strait
other_major_dungeons.special: Whole-floor Monster House on 15; possible 1000 Poke on final floor.

fidelity_notes: Preserve Friend Areas as explorable habitats, not DX camps.
Do not use Mega Rayquaza, Primal Groudon, DX boss terrain gimmicks, DX recruitment guarantees, rare qualities, Mystery Houses, or level-5 challenge resets.
Main-story legendary bosses become recruitment targets after credits; named story NPC encounters are distinct from ordinary same-species recruits.
Recurring ordinary rescues and passage of days gate story events. A campaign implementation can expose clear next objectives while retaining those dependencies.
Rock Path and Snow Path are fugitive training loops; neither replaces the next main dungeon.
Town services, partner relationship, dreams, persecution, vindication, base rebuilding, meteor ending and Gengar redemption are structural beats, not optional flavor if claiming whole-story coverage.
uncertainties_and_source_quality: Detailed campaign facts rely on the user-requested Bulbapedia walkthrough and specific original-game page sections; official Nintendo/Pokemon sources located did not expose comparable detailed walkthrough text.
Walkthrough Chapter 6 incorrectly calls evolution location Luminous Spring; original location is Luminous Cave, confirmed main article.
Walkthrough Chapter 5 shows contradictory Groudon levels (37 in encounter table, 27 in boss block). Specific Magma Cavern original section gives 27; use 27 for first battle.
Generic dungeon pages mix RB and DX in one article. Only Generation III/original text was used here.

No exhaustive reproduction of exact day counters, all dialogue-choice branches, individual boss moves, or each randomly generated floor layout is supplied. Whole-campaign dependencies, floor counts, setpieces and named encounter targets are supplied.
Silent Chasm and Great Canyon terminal story clearings may be reported separately from random-floor totals; preserve split metadata to avoid off-by-one dungeon generation.

Specific pages correct walkthrough clearing-inclusive numbers: Tiny Woods 3, Thunderwave Cave 5, Great Canyon 12, Mt. Freeze 19 (15+4), Murky Cave 19. Terminal scenes are separate, not additional generated floors.

notes: No ordinary recruitment/items/shops/Monster Houses; team bosses may recruit under special high-level conditions.
